title: A Resting-state EEG Dataset for Sleep Deprivation
description: This dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 71 participants who underwent two sessions of normal sleep and sleep deprivation, with the session order counterbalanced across participants. In addition to EEG data (eyes open and partially eyes closed), the dataset includes measures of participants' sleepiness and mood states, enabling investigation of sleep deprivation effects on brain activity and psychological state.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a Brain Products system with 61 electrodes at a sampling frequency of 500Hz, with impedances kept below 5k.

funding_references.funder_name: National Key Research and Development Program of China
